title: Vehicles: two-seat buggy (driver + gunner)
body: Requested: add vehicles. scripts/buggy.gd: CharacterBody2D buggy, F to enter/exit (shares the M2 mount path), A/D drive, W hop, mounted MG with overheat, run-over damage, 350 HP, explosive damage x1.6, wreck kills occupants + blast, respawn after 25 s. MP: host owns seats/HP/wrecks/respawn, the driver's peer simulates and streams state through Main.net_vehicle_* with sender checks; late-join mirror. tools/place_vehicles.py finds long drivable stretches (87/99 classic maps + built-ins). Map editor Buggy tool, Settings -> Game toggle. Tests: tools/vehicle_test.gd (gate F), gate C 'drive'.

title: Pickups error when a non-soldier body enters them
body: bonus_pickup.gd / weapon_pickup.gd called bool(body.get('dead')) on any CharacterBody2D; a buggy has no 'dead' -> 'Nonexistent bool constructor'. Vehicles are now ignored.

title: Buggy: solo driver firing penalty, bot gunners, vehicle HUD
body: Feedback: a lone driver who can also shoot is too strong. Solo firing now caps speed at 50% and doubles spread. Team-mode teammate bots board a nearby buggy as gunner (bot.gd _think_ride, Main.vehicle_bot_board/net_vehicle_seat_bot), aim with lead, burst-fire under the overheat threshold and leave when the driver does. HUD shows buggy HP, gun heat, gunner, solo note. tools/vehicle_crew_test.gd in gate F.
